title: NBA GM — official NBA roster and broad position reconciliation, 30 clubs
scope: Every Octagon proposed NBA GM candidate matched with a current NBA.com team roster at the October 29, 2026 editorial snapshot. Broad F/G/C tags read from NBA.com; specific game PG/SG/SF/PF/C slot eligibility, full canonical IDs, contracts, skills and live roster recency remain unverified.
nbaSourceCaution: NBA.com may have current after-snapshot transactions; recheck at publication. 'F' and 'G' are not automatic exact PG/SG/SF/PF eligibility. Ten New York and twelve Utah individual profiles were directly linked from NBA.com October rosters; roster-level G/F/C not exact slot eligibility. Nine Brooklyn and ten Chicago NBA.com individual player IDs linked from roster. 'Egor Dëmin' accented NBA display resolves Octagon 'Egor Demin' identity. See docs/nba-gm-official-24-den-gsw-profiles-2026-10-30.md. Exact playable roles and all skills remain provisional. October 30: 22 direct official Washington/Charlotte NBA.com roster-profile links checked; see docs/nba-gm-official-22-was-cha-profiles-2026-10-30.md.
